chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Speech concerning truth is better than silence over falsehood.

key_terms.بَاطِلٍ: falsehood, vanity, or what is invalid and wrong
key_terms.حَقٍّ: truth, right, and what is just and correct

ai.seo_question: Is speaking the truth better than remaining silent in the face of falsehood?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches that speaking in support of truth is superior to remaining silent when faced with falsehood. The saying emphasizes moral responsibility in speech and the virtue of standing with what is right.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5844 - Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), said:
"Speaking the truth is better than remaining silent upon falsehood."
